what: Janus 1-F stage 1 (J1F-A) parent copy of Janus 0's output heads (F-A2, master plan §2). Every decoder.seg_layers head of Janus 0 (5 channels; deep supervision included) becomes a 13-channel head: a class Janus 0 has keeps its own row; a new class copies its parent's row; every channel of a territory (the parent and its children) gets the parent's bias minus log(k), k the territory's channel count, so each territory's softmax mass equals Janus 0's probability of it at step 0 (experiments/Delta/j1f_r1/parent_copy.py).
